name: Integration puzzle that snaps together
description: Represent connected products or integrations as a satisfying assembly. Builds an editable 10-second vertical ad from your images, logo and copy. AI can suggest options from a website to fill the fields with its copy and images. No generated video.
tagline: Assembly is a useful metaphor for supported integrations or components.

props.subtitle: A 5-scene vertical ad, 10 seconds long. You supply images and short lines of copy. The app builds an editable cut, not a generated video.

props.text: Lays out every frame and finishes the cut. Pick one that reads images. Saved for next time.
Optional. Paints backgrounds and decoration for the layout. Saved for next time.

props.label: How do you want to start?

options.title: Fill from a website
options.description: Paste a product page. AI suggests the copy and images.

props.label: Website
props.hint: The agent reads the page with the finishing model and suggests three filled versions, with real images from the site. Pick one, then check each step.

props.text: No site at hand? Try this one.

props.label: Agent
props.placeholder: The agent's reading and image searches appear here.

props.subtitle: Four tiles, one for each tool you connect. Use logos or icons on a plain background.

props.label: Connection line
props.hint: Shows as the tiles move into place.

props.subtitle: The finished object pulses once. Then a short benefit sits beside it.

props.label: Benefit
props.placeholder: One workflow, no copy and paste

props.subtitle: The finished object holds with the next step.

props.label: Layout agent
props.placeholder: The agent's layout edits and frame reviews appear here.

props.title: The layout needs a look
props.text: Edit the cut or plan again. You can still approve it.

value.title: Integration puzzle that snaps together
value.objective: Represent connected products or integrations as a satisfying assembly.
value.direction: Separate elements become one coherent object; the assembly is the proof metaphor, not the actual proof of integration.
beats: 0–1.5 s: Separated tiles or a partly assembled object are already visible. Shows Brand color, Tile 1, Tile 2, Tile 3, Tile 4, Problem.
1.5–4 s: Tiles move toward their assigned cells. Shows Brand color, Tile 1, Tile 2, Tile 3, Tile 4, Connection line.
4–6.5 s: The completed object rotates slightly or pulses once. Shows Brand color, Tile 1, Tile 2, Tile 3, Tile 4, Benefit.
6.5–8 s: Short supported benefit sits beside the coherent system. Shows Brand color, Tile 1, Tile 2, Tile 3, Tile 4, Benefit detail.
8–10 s: Final object and next step. Shows Brand color, Tile 1, Tile 2, Tile 3, Tile 4, Logo, Call to action.
